description: Instantiate a built-in recipe by id (from list_recipes) inside a COMP — a tested, ready-made network you can build in one call, then tweak. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path`, adds and wires every node the recipe declares, exposes its controls, then auto-layouts, verifies, and previews. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, all created node paths, the output path, the recipe id, exposed controls, any node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image. Returns a friendly error listing available ids if `id` is unknown.

parent_path.description: COMP to build the recipe inside.

name: apply_recipe
title: Apply recipe
